pattern.description: A single hero 'Transcription' card shrinks and slides left to become the first node of a horizontal pipeline while the remaining stage cards and dashed connector arcs stream in from the right, ending in a branch to Phone and Website outputs.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous move turns a single concept into the full system map without a cut; the left-to-right stagger mirrors the data flow and the dashed arcs make the chain read as connected stages.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.hero-card', {scale: 0.45, x: '-=420', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.inOut'}); tl.from('.stage-card', {x: 120, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.05}, '<0.1'); tl.from('.arc path', {drawSVG: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.05}, '<'); tl.from('.output-card', {scale: 0.8, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'back.out(1.4)', stagger: 0.06}, '-=0.2'); dim non-active cards with a color/opacity tween afterwards.
build_hint.remotion: Drive group scale/translateX with spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}) (no overshoot); each stage card uses the same spring delayed by i*2 frames for translateX(120->0) and opacity; arcs use interpolate on strokeDashoffset; output cards use spring with damping ~14 for a light pop.

notes: Event window is short (0.37 s) and the start frame is a zoomed hero card, so it is ambiguous whether this is a layout reframe or a scene-level zoom-out; camera verdict is none, so treated as content reframe. Turn taking/LLM cards appear greyed in the end frame (likely a highlight sweep), recorded as color_shift. Text-to-Speech card has no card-level box; b18 (its label) used.
